subject: planner: Use NDV from the sample for TopN/Buckets (#62094)
summary: Changes `pkg/statistics.BuildHistAndTopN` to track distinct count within the *sample* (`sampleNDV`) while building TopN. When sampling and the full NDV (from FM sketch) exceeds the sample NDV but TopN would otherwise cover all distinct sampled values, it trims TopN (keeping `max(1, sampleNDV-1)`) so histogram buckets can still be built (or at least leave mass for non-TopN values when buckets are disabled). It also gates TopN-exclusion from samples on `numBuckets > 0`, updates/extends unit coverage, and stabilizes an analyze test by disabling auto analyze during the test.
